pr_title: Support redundant department disable in scope of `RedundantCopDisable`
pr_body:
Fixes #11213 

The `Registry#disabled?` was not including cops disabled via department config like `Metrics => {'Enabled' => false}` this is why I added a new `Registry#find_cops_by_directive` which also finds cops for given department config (`#find_by_cop_name` ignores it since a department is not a cop).

issue_context.title: Add department support to RedundantCopDisableDirective
issue_context.body:
As identified in #11210 rubocop currently errors out when trying to detect redundant department disables. 

--------

## Expected behavior

Offense detected: `W: [Correctable] Lint/RedundantCopDisableDirective: Unnecessary disabling of Metrics department.`

## Actual behavior

Error message: `Couldn't find Metrics/CyclomaticComplexity in comment: # rubocop:disable Metrics`

## Steps to reproduce the problem

1. Double disable comment
```
# rubocop:disable Metrics
# rubocop:disable Metrics
```
2. Config + comment
example.rb: `# rubocop:disable Metrics`
rubocop.yml: `Metrics: { Enabled: false }`

## RuboCop version

All versions

review_comments: just moving it into a reusable method. I could make it private as well, but it seems useful as a public one (potentially?)
I just copied cop-specific tests and changed them to be about department
This part was ignoring configs like `Metrics => { Enabled: false }`
